pages.text: After the first vial breaks, look for a split fleshy mound with radiating veins in the Overworld or city. The entrance is a shaft: plan your descent and exit. The central hangar connects to stores, armories and laboratories.
Explore the hatcheries beyond the hangar. Swelling hive entities release defenders; destroying a hive removes that threat. Grow your own two-way passage using living hive tissue.
